verdict.rationale: BigQuery sharing (formerly Analytics Hub) is documented as a data exchange where analysts can discover curated third-party and Google datasets and combine them with their own internal data. Access works across organizational boundaries without replicating data, and listings can be monetized via Google Cloud Marketplace, which covers the in-platform enrichment story. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the marketplace enrichment workflow, and detail on catalog breadth or listing quality.
